source_name: Vision2030.ai / trade press reporting on Nov 2025 Commerce authorization
rationale: On 19 Nov 2025 Commerce authorized HUMAIN (and separately UAE's G42) to each purchase up to the equivalent of 35,000 Nvidia GB300-class accelerators, subject to security/reporting conditions and BIS compliance monitoring. This is favorable but capped, conditional, and short of a country-wide rule -- Saudi Arabia did not receive the UAE's July 2026 upgrade.

Scored above the floor given Qatar's Al Udeid Air Base hosting and active US security relationship, but this remains a judgment call. A future session with unrestricted access should check BIS's Interactive Country Groups tool directly.
